references.title: HiPi: Reproducible High-Fidelity Piezoresistive Sensors for Robotic Manipulation
references.use: FPCB electrode fabrication and an example of comparing spatial crosstalk with the same sensing layers.
references.limit: The published gripper and array are different. Its reported geometry fidelity and rate are not F1 force/contact results.

references.title: Scaling Fabric-Based Piezoresistive Sensor Arrays for Whole-Body Tactile Sensing
references.use: Grounded inactive rows, selected-column virtual potential, and the limits caused by finite switch resistance.
references.limit: A reference circuit principle, not an ENPIRE adaptation or a 20 N sensor rating.

references.title: BYU tactile-sensor repository
references.limit: The repository says its original piezoresistive fabric is no longer made. F1 needs a separately specified purchasable material.

references.title: FlexiTac hardware repository
references.use: Reference for accessible array assembly and acquisition.
references.limit: Upstream code is labeled CC BY-NC 4.0. No upstream code or hardware file has been copied into F1.
